name: SignGraph meets then beats LangGraph
asks:
signgraph: langgraph

SignGraph is meant to meet then beat LangGraph actually.

against.name: LangGraph
against.domain: stateful graph workflows: conditional routing, fan-out and reducer joins, subgraphs, checkpoints, restart, interrupt and resume, state history and forking, streamed execution

met-when.says: A workflow whose next node is chosen from its state reaches the same final state as LangGraph's StateGraph, against a pinned release of the peer, run on the same input in the same CI job.
A node that fans out to several nodes whose writes a reducer joins gives the same joined state as LangGraph, against a pinned release of the peer, run on the same input in the same CI job.
A workflow that calls another workflow as one node gives the same final state as LangGraph, against a pinned release of the peer, run on the same input in the same CI job.

A run stopped after any step and restarted from its last checkpoint by a new process finishes in the same final state as an uninterrupted run, as LangGraph's does, against a pinned release of the peer, run on the same input in the same CI job. The checkpoint store is a function argument.
A run that stops for outside input and resumes with it finishes in the same state as LangGraph, against a pinned release of the peer, run on the same input in the same CI job.

The states of a run are listed in order, and a run forked from any earlier state proceeds from it without changing the original, as in LangGraph, against a pinned release of the peer, run on the same input in the same CI job.
Each step's state update is delivered to the caller as it is produced, in the same order LangGraph streams them, against a pinned release of the peer, run on the same input in the same CI job.
Replaying a run from any checkpoint with the same inputs reproduces every later checkpoint with the same content address. Claimed only after every meet condition holds.

Two branches that write different values to one key with no reducer do not fail the run and do not overwrite one another: the joined state holds both, each with the path that produced it. Claimed only after every meet condition holds.
